summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 25 tests to tests/test_progress.py, docs in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG bullet. The diff is additive only (857 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing is committed. Tests, black, and mypy were not run, per instructions, so the behavior and typing are unverified. Known risks: module-level open passes a str mode to the Literal-only Progress.open overloads, which may fail strict mypy; the return-value/type-var suppression may be flagged as unused.
